method: Lock the current-main canonical snapshot before editorial selection.
Review all August cards, using the 31 top cards as candidate structural anchors and the 121 high cards as reinforcement/counterevidence rather than article-count votes.
Inspect canonical September 1-9 lineage follow-ups to test whether late evidence overturns the August diagnosis.
Run a targeted missed-treasure search for material policy, project-execution, supply-chain and financing evidence not represented in the locked August source set.
Reject narratives that are contradicted by governed evidence, including the simple EV-down/ESS-replaces-EV framing.
Select the smallest set of distinct monthly flows that explains the month without importing the newsletter's six-signal structure.
Use only locked August canonical cards as official source_card_ids and public refs. Late non-canonical evidence may inform red-team judgment but not official citations.

selected_flows.title: ESS, 계약·금융·COD가 이어지는 전력 인프라로
selected_flows.reason: Multiple regions supplied independent execution stages in the same month: long-term revenue contracts, financial close, construction start and commercial operation. This is stronger than shipment growth alone.

selected_flows.title: 생산자산, EV 단일축에서 용도·화학계 혼합으로 재배치
selected_flows.reason: The month showed a new U.S. plant entering production alongside a planned EV-NCM/ESS-LFP product mix, a binding U.S. LFP supply contract, OEM multi-chemistry strategy and sodium-ion manufacturing. Simultaneous EV-battery growth rules out an EV-disappearance interpretation.

selected_flows.title: 현지화, 공장 위치에서 원료·재활용·자본·전력망 보안으로 확대
selected_flows.reason: Policy and capital instruments reached a one-year export restriction on recycling feedstock, bulk-power equipment/software security, conditional strategic lending and binding domestic lithium offtake. Localisation therefore became a multi-layer eligibility and control problem, not merely plant location.

selected_flows.title: 중국, 규모 확대와 이용률·수익성 압력이 동시에 커짐
selected_flows.reason: China combined very large cumulative storage scale and new manufacturing starts with year-on-year declines in H1 new commissioning and a clarified consumption-tax boundary. The relevant next metric is execution quality, utilisation and tax-adjusted economics rather than announced capacity alone.

rejected_or_narrowed_narratives.narrative: EV 둔화가 ESS 성장으로 단순 대체됐다
rejected_or_narrowed_narratives.reason: The locked August universe contains global H1 ESS battery shipments +71% and global H1 EV-battery use +20% at the same time; post-month 1-7 month EV-battery data also remained positive. The supported interpretation is diversification and differentiated execution speed, not one-for-one substitution.
The August 26 order creates a DOE risk-review and transaction-control framework tied to covered foreign entities and unacceptable risk; it is not a blanket ban on all foreign equipment.

rejected_or_narrowed_narratives.narrative: 중국 ESS는 성장 둔화 국면이므로 규모 확대가 끝났다
rejected_or_narrowed_narratives.reason: New H1 commissioning declined year on year, but cumulative new-storage scale reached 168.3GW/448.7GWh and new cell/BESS assets continued entering operation. The evidence supports a shift toward utilisation/economics, not a halt in build-out.

rejected_or_narrowed_narratives.narrative: 정부·프로젝트 금융 약정은 이미 집행된 자금이다
rejected_or_narrowed_narratives.reason: Conditional or preliminary financing items are kept explicitly conditional; final disbursement and project execution remain watchpoints.

post_month_counterevidence.finding: China's 2% battery consumption tax took effect on September 1, supporting the August view that tax-adjusted product economics and product boundaries matter.
A Brazilian court halt at Sigma Lithium added an operating-risk counterpoint to lithium supply recovery expectations.
Global EV-battery use for January-July remained up 20.4% year on year, reinforcing rejection of the EV-disappearance narrative.

A September report on an August urgent call from EU strategic-mineral project developers highlighted liquidity and financing delays. It was used only as red-team counterevidence against assuming policy designation automatically creates executable financing, and was excluded from official refs because it was not in the locked August canonical snapshot.

source.title: Some critical mineral firms chosen by EU flag project liquidity concerns

post_month_counterevidence.finding: The September China battery-storage manufacturing approval pause was treated as later reinforcement of capacity-discipline concerns, not retroactive August evidence.

official_source_selection.selection_principle: Use decision-relevant anchors that collectively prove the four flows; avoid citing every reinforcing card or double-counting repeated stages. Global aggregate cards may support the executive diagnosis without being attached to a region-specific flow. Post-month claim enrichments are excluded from official August refs when the public source binding would cross the month boundary.

qc.review_remediation: PASS — Lansing production start is separated from planned product mix; black-mass wording is narrowed to the governed one-year export restriction; the Jianxiawo post-month-enriched ref is removed from official August evidence; non-canonical EU liquidity counterevidence now carries source provenance.
